page.overview:
What is Northern Cave?

The Northern Cave, also called the Great Cavity is a location and the final dungeon of Final Fantasy VII. It is situated at the bottom of the North Crater that takes up much of the northern continent of the planet. Within it is a large cave system connected to the Planet's Core where Sephiroth waits, and is fought as the game's final boss.

The Northern Cave was created with the North Crater when the asteroid containing Jenova crashed into the planet over 2,000 years before Final Fantasy VII.

In October 0002, when Sephiroth was defeated at the Nibel Reactor during the Nibelheim Incident, he traveled through the lifestream to the Northern Cave to recuperate. Years later, Sephiroth led the Sephiroth-clones to the cave.

In "That Which Waits in the Northernmost Reaches" in Final Fantasy VII, taking place December 0007, Cloud Strife and his party reached Sephiroth in the Northern Cave, bringing the Black Materia, which is used to summon Meteor. Sephiroth then taunted Cloud, telling him he was another drone like all the other mindless Sephiroth-clones, causing Cloud to break down. Sephiroth then tricked the party into giving him the Black Materia. The Weapons awoke, sensing the cataclysm from Sephiroth summoning Meteor, and Sephiroth sealed the crater's entry with a force-field, preparing for his ascension to godhood.
